crossRefs.note: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be…
crossRefs.keyword: thee. Heb. upon thee. and ye

crossRefs.note: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought Yahweh of Armies.
Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one…

translations.web: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, strike.
translations.bsb: I will not look on you with pity, nor will I spare you, but I will punish you for your ways and for the abominations among you. Then you will know that it is I, the LORD, who strikes the blow.
translations.kjv: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD that smiteth.
translations.asv: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will bring upon thee according to thy ways; and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, do smite.
